lines.en: label makotospring3:
scene sky
I’ve been feeling a little better ever since Wakana showed up at my house to not give me a blowjob.
lines.zh: 自从 Wakana 来我家、却没给我口交之后，我的心情稍微好了一些。

lines.en: And while I’m sure I could multiply that feeling tenfold by visiting everyone else who cares about me and hasn’t moved out, I’ve elected to just wander around town this morning instead.
lines.zh: 虽然我很清楚，只要去探望所有还在乎我、又还没搬走的人，这份心情就能翻上十倍，但我还是选择今天早上一个人在城里闲逛。

lines.en: So today, it’s less I’m wallowing in my hopelessness and more like I’m going on a leisurely stroll with it — where the two of us will awkwardly attempt to get to know each other a little better.
lines.zh: 所以今天与其说我是在绝望里打滚，不如说我是带着绝望一起悠闲散步——我们两个会笨拙地试图多了解彼此一点。

lines.en: As it turns out, my shadow has also had three great loves and managed to squander each of them.
lines.zh: 结果发现，我的影子也曾有过三段刻骨铭心的恋情，而且每一段都被它浪费掉了。

lines.en: He’s not as perturbed by the heat, though. And he doesn’t mind the unpredictable weather patterns ushered in by whatever season we’re in.
lines.zh: 不过他没那么怕热。也不介意这个不知名的季节带来的变幻莫测的天气。

lines.en: I think it’s spring, but I forget sometimes. So I ask him and he tells me I’m correct.
lines.zh: 我觉得现在是春天，但我有时会忘。于是我问他，他说我没错。

lines.en: He can read my thoughts, but I can’t read his. And I find that unfair because he is a parasitic being who can’t detach himself and live without me.
lines.zh: 他能读我的心思，我却读不了他的。我觉得这不公平，因为他是个寄生物，离了我活不下去，也甩不掉。

lines.en: {size=-1}Regardless, our spontaneous bout of camaraderie proceeds as I do one more lap around the block and tell myself it is the last. That I don’t care to learn more about hopelessness when I’m already so familiar with it.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-1}无论如何，我们这场突如其来的情谊继续着，我绕着街区又走了一圈，告诉自己这是最后一圈。既然我对绝望已经这么熟悉，就没必要再了解更多了。{/size}

lines.en: This mistake has been mostly harmless, though. And by “harmless” I mean that, in the event of suffering, it can only happen to me or the shadow.
lines.zh: 不过这个错误大体上是无害的。而所谓「无害」，是指在受苦这件事上，受苦的只会是我，或者影子。

lines.en: And by “me or the shadow” I just mean me. Because no matter how many times I step on him, he does not cry out.
lines.zh: 而所谓「我或影子」，其实就是我。因为不管我踩他多少次，他都不会叫出声。

lines.en: How annoying it is for my unwanted offspring to be the one impervious to pain while I ascend these stairs with a mental limp.
lines.zh: 我那不请自来的后代对疼痛免疫，而我却拖着精神上的跛足爬这些台阶，真是让人恼火。

lines.en: It’s just then that my phone rings, though. And of course I answer it because, despite how desperately I wish to be alone, I just can’t bring myself to be alone.
lines.zh: 就在这时，我的手机响了。我当然接了——因为尽管我拼命想一个人待着，我却怎么也做不到真的一个人待着。

lines.en: The shadow laughs and peels itself off of me, leaving me forever as I swallow its name and tap on a piece of glass.
lines.zh: 影子笑着从我身上剥离下来，永远地离开了我，而我咽下它的名字，在一块玻璃上敲了敲。

lines.en: : Hello?
: {i}Good morning, Sensei. You’re not busy right now, are you?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}早上好，老师。你现在不忙吧？{/i}

lines.en: : Does being sad count as being busy?
lines.zh: : 难过算忙吗？

lines.en: : {i}I hope not as my schedule would be packed for the rest of eternity if that were the case.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}希望不算，否则我的日程会一直排到永恒之后。{/i}

lines.en: : Want to come over and have another marathon of sex? I have the house all to myself because everyone hates me now.
lines.zh: : 要不要过来再来一场马拉松式的性爱？现在整栋房子都是我一个人的，因为大家都讨厌我了。

lines.en: : {i}As fun as that sounds, and it does sound very fun, I was actually wondering if you’d want to get coffee instead. On me, of course.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}听上去很有意思，确实很有意思，不过我其实想问你愿不愿意改喝咖啡。当然，我请客。{/i}

lines.en: : Why would I want to get coffee on you? That sounds like a lawsuit waiting to happen and I know that you’re an attorney now.
lines.zh: : 我干嘛要把咖啡洒在你身上？听上去就像一场随时会发生的诉讼，而且我知道你现在是律师了。

lines.en: : {i}Okay. Allow me to rephrase that then if you’re going to be difficult today. Can I put on a dress and buy you coffee? I feel like we’ve been under-utilizing the infinite amount of time we have here.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好吧。既然你今天非要这么难搞，那就让我换个说法。我能穿上裙子、请你喝咖啡吗？我觉得我们一直没好好利用在这里的无限时间。{/i}

lines.en: : Can I take the dress off afterwards?
lines.zh: : 之后我能把裙子脱了吗？

lines.en: : {i}Oh, you’re wearing one too?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦，你也穿了一条？{/i}

lines.en: : Makoto, if we are so sad, why are we both so funny? It shouldn’t work that way.
lines.zh: : Makoto，既然我们这么难过，为什么我们俩又这么好笑？不该是这样才对。

lines.en: : {i}But it does. And I’m just going to assume that you’re accepting my invitation because you haven’t said no.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可就是这样。而且我就当你接受我的邀请了，因为你还没说不。{/i}

lines.en: : Now you’re speaking my language — dubious consent.
lines.zh: : 现在你说的就是我的语言了——暧昧的同意。

lines.en: : {i}I’ll keep that in mind when I get to take your dress off later.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}等会儿轮到我脱你的裙子时，我会记住这句话的。{/i}

lines.en: scene black
Makoto hangs up the phone and sends me a text telling me to meet her at the park near the school.
lines.zh: Makoto 挂了电话，发了条短信让我去学校附近的公园找她。

lines.en: I send one back saying I need to head back home and get changed first.
lines.zh: 我回了一条，说我需要先回家换身衣服。

lines.en: scene makotocoffeedate1
Of course it’s a lie, though. I’m good at that. Here’s another. Watch.
lines.zh: 当然这是谎话。我擅长这个。再来一个，看着。

lines.en: : I definitely don’t want to fuck you right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在绝对不想操你。

lines.en: : If you tell yourself that enough, it might actually come true one day.
lines.zh: : 如果你对自己说得够多，总有一天它会成真的。

lines.en: : Okay, maybe I’m not as good at lying as I thought.
lines.zh: : 好吧，也许我不像自己以为的那么擅长撒谎。

lines.en: : Oh, I didn’t realize you were going to be practicing today. That’s fine, though. I’m happy so long as we’re together.
lines.zh: : 哦，我不知道你今天打算练习呢。不过没关系。只要我们在一起，我就很高兴。

lines.en: : You’re being very cute today. What’s the catch?
lines.zh: : 你今天可爱得过分。有什么条件？

lines.en: : There is no catch. Also, I’m practicing lying as well.
lines.zh: : 没有条件。还有，我也在练习撒谎。

lines.en: : Okay, so what’s the catch then?
lines.zh: : 好吧，那到底有什么条件？

lines.en: : Walk with me. I’ll tell you on the way.
lines.zh: : 陪我走走吧。路上我跟你说。

lines.en: scene makotocoffeedate2
: So — I wanted to get your feelings on how you want to handle all of this reset stuff since Ayane wants me to start taking more {i}initiative{/i} or something.
lines.zh: : 那个——Ayane 想让我多{i}主动{/i}一点之类的，所以我想听听你对这些重置事件打算怎么处理。

lines.en: : I see. And I assume that you still just don’t really care?
lines.zh: : 明白了。我猜你依然其实并不怎么在乎？

lines.en: : Pretty much, yeah. And since Yumi’s also in the loop as well, no pun intended, I figure we finally have enough people to start forming factions.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧。而且既然 Yumi 也加入进来了——没有双关的意思——我觉得我们终于有足够的人手来组派系了。

lines.en: : Is this you trying to enlist me?
lines.zh: : 你这是在招募我？

lines.en: : Only if it’s working.
lines.zh: : 有效的话就是。

lines.en: scene makotocoffeedate3
: I can’t do that to Ayane. She wants to grow up and have babies and all of that boring stuff.
lines.zh: : 我不能那么对 Ayane。她想长大、想生孩子，还有那一大堆无聊的事。

lines.en: : Also, I think I’d actually be able to follow through with castrating myself if I accidentally reset someone through sex again. So I’d like to avoid that, if possible.
lines.zh: : 还有，如果我再做爱的时候不小心把谁重置了，我觉得这次我会真的把自己阉了。所以可以的话，我想避开那种情况。

lines.en: : Staying abstinent until we figure out the secrets of the universe then?
lines.zh: : 所以在我们弄清宇宙的秘密之前，你要一直禁欲？

lines.en: : Depends on whether or not I’m on the roof of the school.
lines.zh: : 那得看我是不是在学校天台上。

lines.en: : Darn. There goes my next fantasy.
lines.zh: : 可恶。我的下一个幻想泡汤了。

lines.en: scene makotocoffeedate4
: But anyway, since I can’t win you over, which I didn’t really plan on doing in the first place, I figure we should start plotting out our next move.
lines.zh: : 总之，既然我说服不了你——本来我也没打算说服——我觉得我们该开始谋划下一步了。

lines.en: : The beach trip’s coming up soon. Think another slumber party is in the cards? Or should we try something a little different?
lines.zh: : 海边旅行快到了。你觉得还会再来一次睡衣派对吗？还是我们该试试别的？

lines.en: : Didn’t we only do that because we thought a reset was looming?
lines.zh: : 我们当初搞那个，不就是因为觉得重置要来了吗？

lines.en: : That was part of it, I think. But I’m pretty sure Ayane’s main goal was just figuring out who could retain information and who couldn’t.
lines.zh: : 我想那是一部分原因。但我很确定 Ayane 的主要目的只是想弄清谁记得住信息、谁记不住。

lines.en: : It was a fine plan, I think. Or I guess more of a fine {i}idea{/i} than anything else. But we left out a key component for...emotional purposes that I believe we need to start {i}reincorporating.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我觉得那是个不错的计划。或者说，与其说是计划，不如说是个不错的{i}想法{/i}。但我们漏掉了一个关键部分——出于……情感上的考虑，我觉得我们该把它{i}重新加回来{/i}。

lines.en: scene makotocoffeedate5
: You want to bring Maya back into the picture...
lines.zh: : 你想把 Maya 重新拉进来……

lines.en: : She doesn’t change the topic when it comes up. She’s been through this before. But more important than {i}all{/i} of that, she could sense when a reset was coming.
lines.zh: : 每次提起这件事，她都不会岔开话题。她经历过。但比{i}这些都{/i}重要的是，她能感觉到重置要来了。

lines.en: : I figured that was more due to experience than some sort of sixth sense, though.
lines.zh: : 我还以为那更多是因为经验，而不是什么第六感。

lines.en: : Could’ve been. {i}Or{/i} she could be special. Because, based on what I’ve seen, she’s changed more dramatically than anyone else. And that makes her an outlier.
lines.zh: : 也许是。{i}也可能{/i}她确实特殊。因为就我看到的而言，她的变化比任何人都剧烈。这让她成了一个异类。

lines.en: : The only problem is that you and Ayane have some sort of pseudo-PTSD from her past involvement in all of this.
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是，你和 Ayane 因为她过去掺和这些事，都患上了某种伪创伤后应激障碍。

lines.en: : But if you {i}really{/i} want to get out of the loops, that needs to be overcome. And the sooner we get her back to the apocalypse, the better.
lines.zh: : 但如果你们{i}真的{/i}想走出循环，就必须克服这一点。而且越早让她回到那个「末日现场」越好。

lines.en: scene makotocoffeedate6
: Sure. But the real question is how we get her up to the roof in the first place — which is a thing we can’t even figure out for ourselves.
lines.zh: : 行。但真正的问题是我们到底怎么把她弄到天台上去——这件事连我们自己都搞不明白。

lines.en: : What if it doesn’t {i}need{/i} to be the roof, though?
lines.zh: : 可如果不是{i}非得{/i}是天台呢？

lines.en: scene makotocoffeedate7
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Think about it — why would a singular rooftop make any sort of difference in a timeloop? Is there any specific {i}reason{/i} we go there?
lines.zh: : 你想想——在一个时间循环里，为什么偏偏一个天台会有影响？我们去那儿有什么特别的{i}理由{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Or are we just following the footsteps laid by someone who ultimately and tragically failed?
lines.zh: : 还是说我们只是在沿着某个最终惨败的人留下的脚印走？

lines.en: : You’re proposing that we just...sit through the next one then? Risk our memories just to see what happens?
lines.zh: : 你是说我们就这么……硬扛过下一次？拿我们的记忆冒险，只为看看会发生什么？

lines.en: : Well, let me ask you this — how attached are you to the {i}current{/i} Maya?
lines.zh: : 那我问你——你对{i}现在的这个{/i} Maya 有多在乎？
: ……为什么这么问？

lines.en: : Because I need to know how sad you’ll be if she winds up getting reset {i}again.{/i}
lines.zh: : 因为我得知道，如果她{i}又{/i}被重置了，你会有多难过。

lines.en: : Are you trying to...{i}sacrifice{/i} her, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 你是想……{i}牺牲{/i}她吗，Makoto？

lines.en: scene makotocoffeedate8
: Not {i}exactly.{/i} I’m just willing to {i}risk{/i} it.
lines.zh: : {i}不完全是{/i}。我只是愿意{i}冒这个险{/i}。

lines.en: : If we can get Maya to come back into the picture and leave her somewhere {i}outside{/i} of the rooftop during a reset...if she makes it through, it changes everything.
lines.zh: : 如果我们能让 Maya 重新入局，重置时把她留在天台{i}以外{/i}的地方……如果她能挺过来，一切都会改变。

lines.en: : And if she doesn’t, nothing of value is lost. We just get a new one.
lines.zh: : 如果她挺不过来，也没损失什么有价值的东西。我们只是换一个新的。

lines.en: : Of course, this is only if {i}you guys{/i} are willing, though. Since {i}you’re{/i} the ones who might be upset if it doesn’t work out.
lines.zh: : 当然，前提是{i}你们{/i}愿意。毕竟万一没成，难过的是{i}你们{/i}。

lines.en: : That’s...
scene makotocoffeedate9
: I don’t know, Makoto...I think we can come up with something better.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Makoto……我觉得我们能想出更好的办法。

lines.en: : If you can, feel free. I’m just throwing out ideas. And I don’t blame you at all for falling for her all over again if {i}that’s{/i} why you’re hesitating. She {i}is{/i} your Juliet after all.
lines.zh: : 能想到尽管说。我只是随口抛点想法。如果你犹豫是因为{i}又一次爱上了她{/i}，我一点也不怪你。她{i}毕竟{/i}是你的 Juliet。

lines.en: : Have you brought this up to Ayane yet?
lines.zh: : 你跟 Ayane 提过这个了吗？

lines.en: : I wanted to test it on you first. Mostly just to see if I could convince you to give up entirely, though.
lines.zh: : 我想先在你身上试试。不过主要是想看看能不能说服你彻底放弃。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是吗……

lines.en: scene black
: I think there might be a better chance of that, to be honest...
lines.zh: : 说实话，我觉得那个倒是更有可能……

lines.en: scene makotocoffeedate10
: Hey, Sensei! Hey, Makoto! I’m not jealous at all right now!
lines.zh: : 嗨，老师！嗨，Makoto！我现在一点都不嫉妒！

lines.en: : You don’t mind that we came here on our {i}date...{/i}do you, Rin?
lines.zh: : 我们来这里{i}约会{/i}你不介意吧……Rin？

lines.en: scene makotocoffeedate11
: Nope! Like I said, not jealous at all! Just your average barista working her average job, totally single and totally not crushing on your man!
lines.zh: : 不介意！我都说了，一点都不嫉妒！只是个普通的咖啡师在打她普通的工，完完全全单身，完完全全没有暗恋你们的男人！

lines.en: : Oh, so you’re just open about it now then.
lines.zh: : 哦，那你现在倒是坦白了。

lines.en: scene makotocoffeedate12
: I go on break in thirty minutes. How about a double date? I get you and Makoto can have Haruka.
lines.zh: : 我三十分钟后休息。来个四人约会怎么样？我要你，Makoto 可以要 Haruka。

lines.en: : I think that’d make Haruka happy at least.
lines.zh: : 至少 Haruka 会开心吧。

lines.en: : You can take Haruka, Rin. You’re the one here who likes girls. I’ll keep my original date.
lines.zh: : 你带走 Haruka 吧，Rin。这里喜欢女生的人是你。我留着我原来的约会对象。

lines.en: scene makotocoffeedate13
: Okay, new plan. {i}He{/i} gets Haruka and then you and I date. That way, we both lose and everything is fair again.
lines.zh: : 好吧，新计划。{i}他{/i}要 Haruka，然后你和我约会。这样我们俩都输，一切就又公平了。

lines.en: : Doesn’t Haruka win if we do that?
lines.zh: : 那样的话赢的不是 Haruka 吗？

lines.en: scene makotocoffeedate14
: Okay! Final suggestion! {i}You{/i} go sit on the right side of the cafe and us three girls will hang out over on the left. Are we in agreement?
lines.zh: : 好吧！最后一个提议！{i}你{/i}去咖啡厅右边坐着，我们三个女生在左边玩。成交吗？

lines.en: : Can you just take my money please? Two coffees.
lines.zh: : 你能不能干脆收我的钱？两杯咖啡。

lines.en: scene makotocoffeedate15
: Who’s the second one for? Me or Haruka?
lines.zh: : 第二杯给谁？我还是 Haruka？

lines.en: : Sensei.
lines.zh: : 老师。

lines.en: : That’s not what we agreed on.
lines.zh: : 我们说好的不是这个。

lines.en: scene makotocoffeedate16
: We never agreed on anything! Just take my money and stop trying to steal my date!
lines.zh: : 我们从来就没说好过什么！收我的钱，别再想着抢我的约会对象了！

lines.en: : You guys are gonna have sex after this, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你们待会儿要去上床，对吧？

lines.en: : Maybe!
lines.zh: : 也许吧！

lines.en: scene black
: Two coffees...that’ll be one million yen.
lines.zh: : 两杯咖啡……一共一百万日元。

lines.en: : No it won’t! Charge us the normal price!
lines.zh: : 才不是！按正常价格收！

lines.en: scene makotocoffeedate17
: Sorry about that. Rin is apparently aggressively pursuing me now to make up for lost time.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。Rin 现在显然在疯狂追我，想把错过的补回来。

lines.en: : To be honest, I’m surprised it’s taken her this long. Have the two of you even kissed yet?
lines.zh: : 说实话，我挺惊讶她居然忍了这么久。你们俩接吻了吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. That’s it, though.
lines.zh: : 接过。不过仅此而已。

lines.en: : Really? So am {i}I{/i} the special one then for having you take my virginity, like...years before {i}we{/i} kissed?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？那{i}我{/i}岂不是很特别——你拿走我初夜，比{i}我们{/i}接吻早了……好几年？

lines.en: : You’re special in a lot of ways, Makoto. That’s just one of them. Sidenote — do you still have that witch costume?
lines.zh: : 你在很多方面都很特别，Makoto。这只是其中之一。顺便问一句——你那套女巫装还在吗？

lines.en: : I’m going to say no just because I’m acutely aware that you will immediately finish your coffee and drag me out of here for sexual purposes when I still have more things to talk about.
lines.zh: : 我要说不在了，就因为我非常清楚，你会立刻把咖啡喝完，然后为了性把我拖出去，而我还有好多话没说完。

lines.en: : Ugh. But we’ve already talked so much today and you’re so cute.
lines.zh: : 唔。可我们今天已经聊了那么多了，而且你这么可爱。

lines.en: scene makotocoffeedate18
: Well, on the bright side, I want to talk {i}about{/i} sex this time. How’s that for a compromise?
lines.zh: : 往好处想，我这次想{i}聊{/i}的正好是性。这算不算折中？

lines.en: : Oh, fun. What’s up? Hit me.
lines.zh: : 哦，有意思。怎么了？说吧。

lines.en: : Did you tell my mom we’re fucking each other’s brains out?
lines.zh: : 你有没有告诉我妈，我们正把对方的脑子操出来？

lines.en: : Ugh. And here I was expecting this conversation to be enjoyable.
lines.zh: : 唔。我还以为这次对话会挺愉快的呢。

lines.en: : Did you tell her or not?
lines.zh: : 你到底说没说？

lines.en: : No, Makoto. I did not tell your mom that we are having any amount of sex.
lines.zh: : 没有，Makoto。我没有告诉你妈我们在做爱，一次都没有。

lines.en: : I just clued her in on my sexual background and provided a perfect opportunity for her skepticism about what I do with you in private to blossom.
lines.zh: : 我只是让她了解了一下我的性经历，顺便给她对我私下对你做什么的怀疑，提供了完美的滋长空间。

lines.en: : Well, thank you for that. Because I am now being “talked to” on a regular basis and reminded to always be extremely careful when it comes to {i}who{/i} I do things with.
lines.zh: : 那还真是谢谢你了。因为我现在经常被「谈话」，还被反复提醒在跟{i}谁{/i}做这些事时一定要极其小心。

lines.en: : Sounds like good news to me. Your mom is being a mom. Now, you can’t complain about her not being a mom anymore.
lines.zh: : 我听着倒是好消息。你妈终于像个妈了。这下你总不能抱怨她不像个妈了吧。

lines.en: scene makotocoffeedate19
: It’s more just annoying than anything. And I kind of figured you didn’t since you’re not {i}that{/i} self-destructive...But it got me thinking. What if you {i}did?{/i}
lines.zh: : 与其说别的，倒不如说就是烦。而且我大概猜到你没说，毕竟你没{i}那么{/i}自毁……不过这让我想到：如果你{i}说了{/i}呢？

lines.en: : Uhhhh...
: No?
lines.zh: : 没有吧？

lines.en: scene makotocoffeedate20
: Or what if {i}I{/i} did?
lines.zh: : 那如果是{i}我{/i}说的呢？

lines.en: : Why would you? Is there something you’re not telling me about yourself?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要说？你有什么事瞒着我吗？

lines.en: : I’m just still trying to figure out what sort of information sticks and what {i}doesn’t.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我只是还在想弄清楚什么样的信息会留下来，什么样的{i}不会{/i}。

lines.en: : People have their memories purged to a certain extent after the resets, don’t they?
lines.zh: : 重置之后，人的记忆会在某种程度上被清除，不是吗？

lines.en: : Yes, but only regarding information directly relevant to the resets I think. Which is why people like Tsuneyo can catch on and then just...forget.
lines.zh: : 是啊，但我想只限于和重置直接相关的信息。所以像 Tsuneyo 那样的人能察觉到，然后又……忘了。

lines.en: : But there isn’t really, like...a rule-book that tells us what stays and what doesn’t. So I have no idea, really.
lines.zh: : 但其实并没有什么……规则手册告诉我们什么会留下、什么不会。所以我真的不知道。

lines.en: : So theoretically, if she caught us having sex while we were discussing resets and the like, would she forget the entire event? Or would she remember the sex but not the timey-wimey stuff?
lines.zh: : 那理论上，如果她在讨论重置之类的话题时撞见我们做爱，她会把整件事都忘掉吗？还是说她会记得做爱，却忘了那些时空错位的东西？

lines.en: : First, you want to sacrifice Maya. Now, you want to orchestrate a weird sexual event that ends with your mom finding out I’m a predator? This universe has broken you, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 先是要牺牲 Maya，现在又要策划一场诡异的性事，最后让你妈发现我是个捕食者？这个宇宙把你搞坏了，Makoto。

lines.en: : I’m not trying to {i}orchestrate{/i} anything. I’m just trying to figure out how much of a sandbox this world really is.
lines.zh: : 我才没{i}策划{/i}什么。我只是想弄清这个世界到底有多像个沙盒。

lines.en: : My mom knowing about us becomes a much smaller problem if she just {i}stops{/i} knowing after a certain amount of time, right?
lines.zh: : 如果她过一段时间就{i}不记得{/i}了，那我妈知道我们的事也就不是什么大问题了，对吧？

lines.en: : {i}I guess?{/i} But what’s the benefit to her finding out at all?
lines.zh: : {i}大概吧{/i}？可她知道这件事又有什么好处？

lines.en: : Well, I imagine the lectures would stop if she knew it was too late to keep me from you. All of her yapping is ruining my infinite vacation.
lines.zh: : 我想，如果她知道想拦住我跟你在一起已经太迟了，那些说教就会停。她的唠叨正在毁掉我的无限假期。

lines.en: : Lucky. Mine keeps being ruined by me losing the people I love.
lines.zh: : 你真幸运。我的假期总是被我失去所爱之人给毁掉。

lines.en: : I’m still here, aren’t I? Unless you’ve just been lying about loving me this whole time.
lines.zh: : 我不还在吗？除非你一直在骗我说爱我。

lines.en: : Of course I love you, Makoto. I just don’t love you enough to have sex with you in front of your mom.
lines.zh: : 我当然爱你，Makoto。我只是没爱到愿意在你妈面前跟你做爱。

lines.en: : Can you really call that “love” at all then? Plus, I think it’d be a good way to get back at her for all the times I heard her and my dad and whoever else going at it in their bedroom.
lines.zh: : 那这还能叫「爱」吗？再说了，我觉得这是报复她的好办法，报复那些年我听见她和我爸、还有别的谁在他们卧室里乱搞的日子。

lines.en: : Let’s maybe let Miku catch us first before we start bringing your only remaining family back into the picture.
lines.zh: : 要不先让 Miku 撞见我们，再把你仅剩的家人拉进这场戏里吧。

lines.en: : I’m just saying, if we can get a definitive answer about what sort of information carries over from cycle to cycle, we can start pushing people a little harder.
lines.zh: : 我只是说，如果我们能确定什么样的信息会从一个循环带到下一个循环，我们就能开始把人逼得更紧一点。

lines.en: : Which accomplishes what, though? That’s the part I’m not getting.
lines.zh: : 可那又有什么用？这部分我不明白。

lines.en: : Again — testing the sandbox.
lines.zh: : 还是那句话——测试这个沙盒。

lines.en: : Maybe we just haven’t gotten anywhere because we haven’t been trying hard enough? And maybe there’s something {i}so{/i} terrible that doing it would {i}force{/i} a reset?
lines.zh: : 也许我们一直没进展，只是因为我们不够用力？也许有某件事{i}糟到{/i}做了它就会{i}强制触发{/i}重置？

lines.en: : I don’t-
lines.zh: : 我不——

lines.en: : I had a dream recently, Sensei. That this world was alive and we were its entertainment. Little ants rummaging through a thin, plastic rectangle in the room of some god or something.
lines.zh: : 我最近做了个梦，老师。梦见这个世界是活的，而我们是它的消遣。小小的蚂蚁在某个神之类的房间里，在一个薄薄的塑料长方块里翻来翻去。

lines.en: : Now, if you had an ant farm, and the ants built their little tunnel and just started living normal, peaceful lives...you’d get bored of them pretty quickly, right?
lines.zh: : 如果你有个蚂蚁工坊，蚂蚁挖好了它们的小隧道，开始过上正常又平静的生活……你很快就会看腻它们，对吧？

lines.en: : But you could make them dig all over again if you just picked up the ant farm and shook it.
lines.zh: : 可你只要把蚂蚁工坊拿起来摇一摇，就能让它们重新再挖一遍。

lines.en: : Maybe that’s what resets are? Maybe we’ve made our tunnel and are just going about our days now like they don’t matter at all.
lines.zh: : 也许重置就是这么回事？也许我们已经挖好了隧道，现在只是在过日子，好像这些日子一点都不重要。

lines.en: : So you...what? Want to build a second tunnel? Add a little annex or something?
lines.zh: : 所以你……什么？想挖第二条隧道？加个小偏房之类的？

lines.en: : Not at all. I {i}want{/i} to stay here. I like living on the farm.
lines.zh: : 完全不是。我{i}想{/i}留在这儿。我喜欢住在这个工坊里。

lines.en: : I just know a few ants who don’t. And there’s plenty of sand lying around that we could build a bridge or a staircase with if we all worked together.
lines.zh: : 我只是认识几只不想留下的蚂蚁。周围还散着很多沙子，要是我们一起动手，够我们搭一座桥或者一道楼梯了。

lines.en: : It’d mean acting...{i}differently,{/i} though. Deviating from what’s expected from us so there’s never a reason to shake up our home at all.
lines.zh: : 不过这意味着我们要……{i}换一种活法{/i}。偏离别人对我们的期待，好让上面永远没有理由来摇晃我们的家。

lines.en: : But of course, there are plenty of risks associated with that as well. And there’d be nothing stopping our make-believe god from spreading borax all over the floor.
lines.zh: : 当然，这么做也有很多风险。而且没什么能阻止我们那位虚构的神往地上撒满硼砂。

lines.en: : It really just comes down to if you want to take that risk or not.
lines.zh: : 归根结底，就看你愿不愿意冒这个险。

lines.en: : Or if you’d be happier just...lying in the sand with me. And everyone else who doesn’t need to know what happens on the outside.
lines.zh: : 或者你是不是更愿意……就这么和我躺在沙子里。还有那些不需要知道外面发生了什么的人，一起。

lines.en: : This is a...rather chaotic side of you, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 你这……还挺混乱的一面啊，Makoto。

lines.en: : Blame Ayane. She’s the one who told me I needed to try a little harder.
lines.zh: : 怪 Ayane 吧。是她说我需要再努力一点的。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...
lines.zh: : 是吗，嗯……

lines.en: scene black
: I think you might be trying a little {i}too{/i} hard. And I don’t think Ayane will blame you if you tone it down a bit.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你可能努力{i}过头{/i}了。而且你要是收敛一点，Ayane 应该也不会怪你。

lines.en: : {i}Okay...{/i}if that’s what you wish, Sensei.
lines.zh: : {i}好吧……{/i}如果你希望这样，老师。

lines.en: : Let me say this, though...if any of that really seemed like {i}too much{/i} to you?...
lines.zh: : 不过我还是要说一句……如果那些话里真的有什么让你觉得{i}太过分了{/i}？……

lines.en: : You might be better off joining my faction after all.
lines.zh: : 那你可能还是加入我这一派比较好。

lines.en: Makoto and I finish our coffee and return to my house to have copious amounts of sex.
lines.zh: Makoto 和我喝完咖啡，回到我家，做了大量的爱。

lines.en: Before I know it, she is asleep in my bed with her clothes left somewhere near the door.
lines.zh: 不知不觉间，她已经在我的床上睡着了，衣服被丢在门边某处。

lines.en: I slide under the blanket beneath her and close my eyes to try and get some rest.
lines.zh: 我钻进毯子，躺到她下面，闭上眼睛想休息一下。

lines.en: But every once in a while, it feels like there’s something crawling on my leg.
lines.zh: 但时不时地，感觉好像有什么东西在我腿上爬。
